notes.title: FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
Everyone, it's been a pleasure. I'm setting this to go live sometime after I can't go online. 
I volunteered to be a missionary, and that means Morph, and all related development, are to be continued.

Some may be disappointed, and others may not care one way or the other. What matters is, I did it. I managed to finally create and post a game for sale on Steam. After 7 years of failing to create much more than a proof of concept, from a 2D animated tileset in Unity, to a 3D platformer, I finally found my way to Godot. Open sauce (Open Source, sorry we had spaghetti tonight) software. A game engine, made by the people, for the people. 
I never knew it tasted so good. 

When I started Morph in September, I had no idea I would even get to a point where the game would be able to be sold. I'm going to be honest, I believe I was helped by God to be able to do this so quickly. 

That being said, I didn't do everything else myself. 

I want to personally thank ALL of the people who participated in Beta Testing. 

Thank you so much for playing the unfinished and broken versions, and thank you for helping me fix it afterwards by showing me what happened, or telling me. 

Thank you to:

Revelation Studios -Beta Testing, Creation of Music tracks: Distant Reflections (Level 2,) Final Stretch (Level 4)

FISSH -Beta Testing, Being good moral support and influence

SupremeMan1942 -Reported more bugs than any other Beta tester. Dubbed, The Exterminator.

SuperBeefJerkey -Beta Testing, Code Support: Helped solve something that would've ruined the game for everyone, the movement physics. If he hadn't given guidance on the usage of Delta time, the game would've been WAY MORE JANKY.

MjolnirStudios -Motivational Influence, by way of threats to terminate my job as a volunteer worker. Thanks Boss ;)

Reclaimer -Inspiration: You were the entire reason I picked Godot up for the first time

BroVideoGaming -Beta Testing, and recommendations on features, sincere feedback


I hope to repay you all someday. Never stop being awesome!

notes.title: HUGE CHANGES!
notes.content:
ALRIGHTY! A lot to unpack here!


1. LEVEL 1 IS COMPLETELY REWORKED!
Be aware that it will probably need some fixes in the future, so let me know if something needs a look!

2. FIXED SAVE DATA!
Save data now actually works correctly! Yay!

3. Changed the jump up a bit!
Jumping is a bit higher now, so if that feels better, let me know in discussions!

4. Enemies don't hurt you when you killed them already!
Shouldn't have been an issue.

5. Nodes are now implemented into the game starting with this update!
You may notice you don't have your moves from previous updates. That's because they are all collectibles that you need to find in each level!

6. Hints are now a thing! 
I'll be adding a switch in the main menu for you to toggle hints on and off in the next update!

7. BOXES
Need I say more?

+ Other small stuff I don't remember!


Side issues:

Scores required for an A rank are not as hard as before, so be aware that may need tweaking later.

Some animations are a bit janky looking. I'll be smoothing those out as well.




That's about it! Thanks for the support thus far everyone!!

notes.title: YET ANOTHER PHYSICS FIX!
notes.content:
I KNOW I said that I fixed the physics before, but they are now ACTUALLY fixed! YAY!

Added in Fullscreen toggle, and window scaling saves when you exit the game!

Tweaked the physics a bit more, and added in Jetro! A new enemy that's sole purpose in life is to make your life miserable! 

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixed a couple problems!
notes.content:
Changed up the duck through platforms, (DTP) to be a double tap, instead of sitting still and holding it down. 

ALSO! Big thanks to SupremeMan 1942 for showing me the broken options menu back button. I found some stray code that makes it vanish, so yay for bug fixes!

notes.title: Whoopsie Daisy Patch!
notes.content:
-Fixed input map on keyboard to be a little more normal

-Fixed timer, so it resets when you die, unless you haven't gotten a checkpoint yet, then it resets

-Fixed the swippers voice playing even if they just exploded

-Fixed a bug where if you mash the enter button really fast on the main menu it causes the game to crash

I'll be working on these next:

-Working on saving the rank you earn at the end of the stage if it's higher than the last one

-Working on counting up the total amount of metal in each level so you know if you missed something

-Working on adding Input remapping to the settings menu

-Working on making it possible to duck through one way platforms, so you can drop through them at will

-Working on finishing the first level, and making it less frustrating to navigate

notes.title: VICTORY SCREEEEEECH!
notes.content:
You can now complete level 1! I will be reworking it soon.

For now, enjoy:

1. Skill chains!
I added the ability to chain enemies together to get more score!
Use it to get the next thing I added....

2. Ranks!
You can now get a rank from A-D on how well you played the level! The rank is determined by your score, which can be boosted by beating the level faster!

3. Victory screen!
You can now complete the level by reaching the goal hoop! 


I'll be adding in save data for when you get a highscore on levels, and whatever rank you get.

Hope you all enjoy! Make sure to reach out if you break something!
